intro.title: Error Boundary
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular application that demonstrates error boundaries by creating a component that catches and displays errors gracefully. You will learn the core concept of error handling in Angular using lifecycle hooks and custom error handling logic. The main technologies involved are Angular components, TypeScript, and the ErrorHandler interface. By the end, you will understand how to prevent your app from crashing when unexpected errors occur.
intro.usecase: Error boundaries are essential in production Angular applications where components can fail unexpectedly. In a financial dashboard, if a chart component crashes while fetching live market data, an error boundary prevents the entire dashboard from breaking and shows a fallback UI instead. Similarly, in e-commerce product listings, if a product card component fails to render due to missing data, the boundary isolates the error so users can still browse other products. This pattern ensures critical application sections remain functional even when non-critical components encounter errors.
